findings.source_passage: Standing, for the most part, on the hallowed precincts of the quarter-deck, they were careful not to speak or rustle their feet.
findings.why_it_matters: The phrase 'hallowed precincts of the quarter-deck' establishes the hushed, almost sacred atmosphere that makes the hidden sounds below so portentous; its erasure strips the scene of its tonal foundation.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore 'hallowed precincts of the quarter-deck' or a close rendering in the scene-setting line.

findings.source_passage: Aye, you are the chap, ain't ye, that heard the hum of the old Quakeress's knitting-needles fifty miles at sea from Nantucket; you're the chap.
findings.why_it_matters: This line is the comic high point of Cabaco's skepticism and provides vivid characterization through the 'Quakeress's knitting-needles' image—its absence flattens the exchange and eliminates a small but textually distinctive flourish.
findings.suggested_fix: Reinsert Cabaco's Quakeress retort; it is brief enough to include even under compression and carries irreplaceable period voice.

findings.source_passage: Say what ye will, shipmate; I've sharp ears.
findings.source_locator: dialogue, Archy's response before Cabaco's Quakeress line
findings.why_it_matters: This line is the pivot that draws out Cabaco's Quakeress joke and asserts Archy's credibility as a witness; its loss collapses a three-beat exchange into two and loses the setup entirely.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore Archy's 'Say what ye will, shipmate; I've sharp ears' as a brief beat before the Quakeress retort.

findings.source_passage: something of that sort in the wind
findings.source_locator: Archy's final speech, last clause before 'Tish!'
findings.why_it_matters: Archy's report that 'Stubb tell Flask there was something of that sort in the wind' corroborates the rumor structurally; the draft cuts to '—' mid-sentence, losing the confirmatory detail.

summary: Three medium-severity findings (the 'hallowed precincts' atmosphere, the signature Quakeress's-knitting-needles retort, and the missing Archy pivot line) collectively tip the verdict to regenerate, as the draft's compression has flattened the chapter's distinctive comic-ominous texture.
